descriptions.text: New Quest! The Recital. Dinosaur attacks are becoming more and more of a problem in the large settlement of Point Mongo. It started small. A chicken here. An Ursine there. People didn't care so much at first since they were mostly picking off the annoying people. But the attacks are getting worse. The dinosaurs probing the town's defenses are getting bigger... Exterminate the threat. Or, find out what they want, and then give it to them. I'll leave it up to you. Reward: You will receive a Gold Quest Box! You will also receive a free town upgrade!

beats.headline: A town, newly named, with a dinosaur problem
beats.text: Donut renames the settlement Point Mongo and the quest arrives on the same day. Mongo takes her off into the jungle on his back and finds the pack: all female, all mongoliensis, headed by one called Kiwi. When Carl carries Donut back to town, Mongo stays behind.

beats.headline: A name for the thing at the fences
beats.text: Samantha's reconnaissance across the water finds the ursines on the far shore torn apart, and the quest updates with the culprit: Big Tina, the dinosaur behind the raids on Point Mongo.

beats.headline: Kill her or give her what she wants
beats.text: Quest Update. Big Tina is out of control, killing every ursine she can find, and if she is not dealt with soon the High Elves may field their army, which nobody wants. Kill her or give her what she wants. Carl assumes that means killing all the ursine. Princess Donut, who has seen Footloose, says it is obvious: she wants to dance, so they have to finish the recital. A second update arrives once the minions show themselves. Surprise, it says. You don't know the half of it.

beats.headline: The wand casts the Recital
beats.text: From the stage, Donut reads the recharge scroll, and Big Tina's inert wand glows in her claw. It shoots sparkles, and it also casts a spell called The Recital: everyone already staring at the dinosaur is suddenly happy to be there, as if this were something they had been looking forward to. Tina hops, shaking the stage, and twirls. The cretins raise a painted mainsail behind her, and when it drops there are thirty velociraptors plus Mongo and Kiwi in homemade sea-creature costumes.

beats.headline: It was never about the town
beats.text: Donut spends an I Take It All Back potion on Kiwi and turns her back into an Ursine, and Tina recognises her mother. What the child wanted was never the recital: it was the mother the transmutation had turned into a dinosaur, who had been at her side the whole time. The quest closes on that.
